data.name: AION 64 Kbit DRAM (4164-equivalent)

specification.qualification_status: AION-owned part; released package, speed grade, rails, refresh and production yield require qualification before December 1979.

manufacturing_planning.status: Accepted RAM process/repair scenario, not proven yield. Spare structures, retention, repair coverage and speed require qualification; recipe details in memory_manufacturing.json.
manufacturing_planning.boundary: Recurring fabricated/package/test cost; development, masks and fab capital budgeted separately.
manufacturing_planning.revision_policy: 1980 process-control improvement; 1981 repaired 3 um die includes 5% spare area. Evaluate 2.75 um against repaired 3 um; apply only if cheaper. Later 2/1.5 um releases are prospective.
manufacturing_planning.legacy_fields_scope: Top-level die area and maturity describe the original launch revision only; production_revisions are authoritative for dated 1980/81 economics.

specification.electrical_contract: 64K x 1; released pinout/rails/timing/refresh remain gates. Common module interface only after retention, speed and all-bank qualification; no capacity or bus-width change.

manufacturing_requirements: Qualify AION 64K×1 silicon, process, speed/retention bins, refresh, package and power rails for Aurelia+ before December 1979; reuse qualified silicon in Artemis from May 1980. Purchased DRAM maturity is not evidence of AION production yield.

second_source.qualification_status: Alternate-story staged release; exact per-part date and approved ordering code unresolved.
second_source.transfer: AION delivers process-compatible mask sets, reference silicon, manufacturing know-how, tests and qualification support.
second_source.procurement: AION remains launch source. No substitution before per-part electrical/reliability qualification.
